verdict.rationale: Signifyd publishes a comprehensive documented REST API (Sale, Checkout, GetDecision, Chargeback, Webhooks, SDKs) with authentication and clear workflow docs, enabling programmatic/agentic integration. Missing for 10: no llms.txt (404 probe) or explicit AI-agent-oriented tooling/SDK for autonomous agents, and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
